diagnosis_scope: eligible existing Gold-derived learning windows; not all global shock history
shock_horizon: five Korean trading-row intervals, FX and WTI percent, US10Y bp, VIX points
counts: unique dates; overlapping windows vs merged overlapping episodes vs fixed6row spaced sample; episodes are not proven independent events
reaction: observed total stock returns; other shocks simultaneous, not causal effects
ablation: saved perasset LightGBM same settings, expanded pre-shock market AND asset state vs same plus all4realized shocks; not pure market-index-only model; no new training
evaluation: 2023-2026 reused research period, retrospective realized-shock reconstruction, not blind
marginal_factor_effect: no per-factor saved ablation, cannot attribute joint gain to each individual shock
industry: current descriptive business grouping only; not PIT sector membership
